children: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) rose 0.5% Friday after Bank of America increased its price target for the semiconductor company, citing a more favorable outlook for server processor demand.
Analyst Vivek Arya lifted the target to $720 from $620 and kept a Buy rating. The revised target is above the $648.07 Wall Street consensus and represents about 2.41% potential upside.

A recent CPU agreement between Anthropic and Akamai was among the factors behind Arya's updated view. He said the deal adds support for the role of server processors as artificial intelligence applications become more widespread.
Arya estimates the server CPU market could expand from $61 billion in 2026 to $211 billion by 2030. He also raised his AMD estimates by 2% for 2027 and 3% for 2028.

title: 5-Star Analyst Drops Stunning New Price Target on AMD Stock
